records.reason: The complete workflow has initialActivity run and exactly one graph node and exit: run.done: run. Its reachable set is {run}; every exit returns to run and there is no null destination. Activity and routine steps add no exits in this dialect. The self-loop exception needs another reachable terminating path, which the complete source lacks. This makes workflow completion structurally impossible in the touched graph.

findings.summary: The workflow starts at run and its only exit returns to run, leaving no finite path to a null destination.
findings.fix: Provide at least one finite path from initialActivity run to a null destination.
